title: AstroSpecLM: A Spectrum-Language Model for Evidence-Grounded Astronomical Spectral Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.07102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Astronomical spectra encode rich physical information, but drawing scientific conclusions from spectral features typically requires expert interpretation. This paper presents AstroSpecLM, a spectrum-language model that connects one-dimensional DESI spectra with Qwen3-4B to answer questions and provide explanations grounded in spectral evidence. Instead of generating question-answer pairs directly from templates or raw catalog fields, we first distill each spectrum into a compact set of catalog- and spectrum-derived facts, then use these facts as references to generate instruction-following conversations. The resulting model is competitive with specialist supervised baselines on classification and redshift estimation, while additionally producing natural-language explanations that reference specific spectral features. translated_title: AstroSpecLM：一种面向证据支撑的天文光谱分析的光谱-语言模型
translated_abstract: 天文光谱蕴含着丰富的物理信息，但从光谱特征中得出科学结论通常需要专家的解读。本文提出了 AstroSpecLM，这是一个光谱-语言模型，它将一维 DESI 光谱与 Qwen3-4B 相连接，用于回答问题并提供基于光谱证据的解释。我们没有直接从模板或原始星表字段生成问答对，而是首先将每条光谱提炼为一组紧凑的、来源于星表和光谱的事实，然后以这些事实作为参考生成遵循指令的对话。所得模型在分类和红移估计任务上与专业监督基线相当，同时还能生成引用具体光谱特征的自然语言解释。我们的结果表明，将语言模型与一维科学光谱相结合是可行的，并且基于事实……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 AstroSpecLM，通过先将 DESI 一维光谱提炼为事实再据此构建指令对话来训练连接 Qwen3-4B 的光谱-语言模型，使其在分类与红移估计上媲美专业监督基线，并能给出引用具体光谱特征的自然语言解释。
en_tdlr: AstroSpecLM connects one-dimensional DESI spectra with Qwen3-4B, trained on fact-distilled instruction conversations, achieving specialist-level performance on classification and redshift estimation while generating natural-language explanations grounded in specific spectral features.
